name: Textarea
purpose: Multi-line free text with label, description and error wired to ARIA.
notFor: Single-line values — names, references, search terms. That is Input.
A message sent by pressing Enter. That is Composer, which owns the Enter key.
One of a known set of answers. That is Select, RadioGroup or Combobox.

anatomy.note: Rendered only when required. aria-hidden: the required attribute is what announces.

label.meaning: Names the field. Always rendered visibly.
label.note: There is deliberately no hideLabel here, though Input has one. Input's exists for a search field whose purpose is obvious from what surrounds it; a four-line box has no such context, and every hidden-label multi-line field found in the wild was a comment box labelled by a placeholder. A placeholder disappears at the first keystroke and is not a voice-control target (WCAG 2.5.3).

description.meaning: Persistent helper text. Shown above the error, never replaced by it.
description.note: A string, not a slot: it is referenced by aria-describedby, which needs a stable id on a single element. Input, Select and Checkbox agree.

error.note: Its presence is what sets aria-invalid.

rows.note: This is the height API, and it is a promise about the size of the answer being asked for. Guessing low is the expensive direction: the reader writes less than they meant to.

resize.meaning: Which way the reader may resize the field.
resize.note: Component-local, not a system axis. `none` only where the surrounding layout genuinely cannot take the growth — it takes back an affordance the platform gives for free, and the reader with a long answer then proof-reads it through a window too small for it.

required.meaning: Marks the field required, natively and visibly.

keyboard.Tab: Moves focus to the field, and out of it. Native.
keyboard.Enter: Inserts a line break. Native, and the reason this is not Composer — a field that submits on Enter cannot hold a paragraph.

aria.labelling: From the associated <label>, required and always visible. No escape hatch.
aria.focus: Ring on the field itself, from bh-focusable. Never removed on :focus-visible.
aria.announcements: None. The error is in aria-describedby and read on focus. Announcing a validation error as it appears interrupts typing, which is when it usually appears.

attributes.aria-describedby: error id then description id, in that order

content.label: Sentence case, no trailing colon. Name the answer, not the field: "Reason for rejection", not "Comments".
content.error: Say what has to change, in plain language. "This field is required" describes the system's rule rather than the reader's problem.
